title: Spec: constant-rate cover traffic between nodes and gateway
description: Define cover traffic protocol: each node sends one dummy OSCORE packet per TDMA superframe to its preferred gateway, regardless of whether it has real traffic. Gateway responds symmetrically. Dummy packets are OSCORE-encrypted (indistinguishable from real traffic to an observer), padded to one of 2-3 fixed size classes. An observer (including a compromised gateway) sees constant bidirectional traffic — cannot determine when real messages are sent. Add to spec/06-security.md. Cost: ~1 additional TX per superframe per node. At 2s superframes, that's 0.5 pps per node — within duty cycle at SF10.
